_comment: Mappa semantica per early game (Littleroot -> Rustboro).

BIRCH_LAB.desc: Laboratorio del Professor Birch a Littleroot.

objectives: Main goal: finish the game by defeating the Champion and seeing the credits. Always progress the main story when it is safe to do so.

In the early game, when the team is healthy (average team HP >= 50%), prioritize following this story path: PLAYER_HOME_BEDROOM / BIRCH_LAB / LITTLEROOT_CENTER -> ROUTE_101_MID -> OLDALE_CENTER -> ROUTE_102_MID -> PETALBURG_POKECENTER -> RUSTBORO_CENTER -> RUSTBORO_GYM.
Heal at nearest HEAL-type location if average team HP < 30%.
Avoid unnecessary battles when the team is weak; seek trainer battles on ROUTE-type locations when grinding is needed.
Do not stay idle in towns or cities: if you are already at a TOWN or CITY semantic location and the team is healthy, prefer MOVE towards the next story location instead of WAIT or EXPLORE.
